# Ownership

Taking a value out of a place that cannot give it away — a field, an element or a referent — by replacing it or swapping it with another.

<h2 id="replace"><code>Replace&lt;T&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Replace<T>(place: &var T, value: T) -> T
```

Installs `value` in `place` and returns the value that was there.
`place` is borrowed for writing and holds `value` afterwards; the old value is returned to the caller, who owns
it. Nothing is copied and nothing is destroyed.
Cannot fail. Runs in time linear in the size of `T` and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Replace.rux#L16)

**Type parameters**

| Name | Description                                       |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `T`  | the type of the place, deduced from the arguments |

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type     | Description                   |
| ------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `place` | `&var T` | the place to write            |
| `value` | `T`      | the value it holds afterwards |

**Returns**: the value the place held before

<h2 id="swap"><code>Swap&lt;T&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Swap<T>(first: &var T, second: &var T)
```

Exchanges the values of two places.
Both places are borrowed for writing and hold each other's value afterwards. Nothing is copied and nothing is
destroyed.
Cannot fail. Runs in time linear in the size of `T` and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Replace.rux#L34)

**Type parameters**

| Name | Description                                        |
| ---- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `T`  | the type of the places, deduced from the arguments |

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type     | Description     |
| -------- | -------- | --------------- |
| `first`  | `&var T` | one place       |
| `second` | `&var T` | the other place |
